nodes.description: SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure: returns a + b and reverts if the sum overflows.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtraction wrapper that delegates to the three-argument overload with a default error message.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b, string errorMessage): requires b <= a and returns a - b.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): returns a * b, short-circuiting to 0 when a == 0 and requiring c / a == b.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): division wrapper delegating to the three-argument overload.
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b, string errorMessage): requires b > 0 and returns a / b.
SafeMath.mod(uint256 a, uint256 b): modulo wrapper delegating to the three-argument overload.
SafeMath.mod(uint256 a, uint256 b, string errorMessage): requires b != 0 and returns a % b.
Raw unchecked arithmetic 'a + b' inside SafeMath.add before the overflow require; the classic arithmetic boundary of the library.
Low-level external call target.call.value(value)(callData) to an arbitrary caller supplied address inside executeTransaction, executed after the queuedTransactions flag is cleared.
uint public constant GRACE_PERIOD = 14 days; window after eta during which a queued transaction may still be executed.
uint public constant MINIMUM_DELAY = 1 days; lower bound enforced on the timelock delay.
uint public constant MAXIMUM_DELAY = 30 days; upper bound enforced on the timelock delay.
address public admin; principal with rights to queue, cancel and execute transactions.
address public pendingAdmin; candidate that must call acceptAdmin to become admin.
uint public delay; minimum time between queueing and execution of a transaction.
bool public admin_initialized; one-time bootstrap flag that relaxes the msg.sender == address(this) check on the first setPendingAdmin call.
mapping(bytes32 => bool) public queuedTransactions; marks keccak256(target,value,signature,data,eta) hashes that have been queued and not yet executed or cancelled.
TreasuryTimelock constructor(address admin_, uint delay_): validates the delay bounds and initialises admin, delay and admin_initialized.
Payable fallback function () external payable {}; allows the contract to receive ether.
setDelay(uint delay_): self-call only setter that changes the timelock delay within MINIMUM_DELAY/MAXIMUM_DELAY.
acceptAdmin(): lets pendingAdmin take over admin and clears pendingAdmin.
setPendingAdmin(address pendingAdmin_): first call from admin (bootstrap) or self-call afterwards, sets the pending admin.
queueTransaction(address target, uint value, string signature, bytes data, uint eta): admin only, requires eta >= block.timestamp + delay and records the txHash as queued.
cancelTransaction(address target, uint value, string signature, bytes data, uint eta): admin only, clears the queued flag for the computed txHash.

executeTransaction(address target, uint value, string signature, bytes data, uint eta) payable: admin only, validates queue state, timelock and grace period, clears the flag and performs a low-level call.
getBlockTimestamp() internal view returns (uint): thin accessor returning block.timestamp.
msg.sender; externally controlled caller address used for all authorization checks.
block.timestamp; miner influenced time source used for timelock and grace period checks.
Constructor parameter admin_ (address): initial admin value.
Constructor parameter delay_ (uint): initial timelock delay.
setDelay parameter delay_ (uint): new timelock delay value.
setPendingAdmin parameter pendingAdmin_ (address): candidate admin address.
queueTransaction parameter target (address): contract to be called at execution time.
queueTransaction parameter value (uint): wei to forward.
queueTransaction parameter signature (string): function selector string.
queueTransaction parameter data (bytes): ABI encoded arguments.
queueTransaction parameter eta (uint): earliest allowed execution timestamp.
Local bytes32 txHash in queueTransaction, keccak256(abi.encode(target, value, signature, data, eta)).
cancelTransaction parameter target (address): target of the queued transaction.
cancelTransaction parameter value (uint): value of the queued transaction.
cancelTransaction parameter signature (string): signature of the queued transaction.
cancelTransaction parameter data (bytes): calldata of the queued transaction.
cancelTransaction parameter eta (uint): execution timestamp of the queued transaction.
Local bytes32 txHash in cancelTransaction, used as key into queuedTransactions.
executeTransaction parameter target (address): arbitrary address that receives the low-level call.
executeTransaction parameter value (uint): ether amount forwarded to the target call.
executeTransaction parameter signature (string): selector used to build callData.
executeTransaction parameter data (bytes): appended to the selector to build callData.
executeTransaction parameter eta (uint): scheduled execution timestamp compared against block.timestamp.
Local bytes32 txHash in executeTransaction used to look up and clear queuedTransactions.
Local bytes callData in executeTransaction, either the raw data or abi.encodePacked(selector, data).
Local bool success returned by the low-level call and required to be true.
Local bytes returnData returned by the low-level call and forwarded to the caller.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns parameter admin_ into the admin state variable.
Constructor assigns parameter delay_ into the delay state variable after bound checks.
Constructor reads MINIMUM_DELAY to require delay_ >= MINIMUM_DELAY.
Constructor reads MAXIMUM_DELAY to require delay_ <= MAXIMUM_DELAY.
setDelay writes parameter delay_ into the delay state variable.
setDelay requires msg.sender == address(this), so caller identity gates the delay update.
setDelay reads MINIMUM_DELAY for its lower bound require.
setDelay reads MAXIMUM_DELAY for its upper bound require.
acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin before granting rights.
acceptAdmin stores msg.sender directly into admin, transferring privileged control.
setPendingAdmin requires msg.sender == admin on the bootstrap path and == address(this) afterwards.
admin_initialized decides which msg.sender authorization branch setPendingAdmin takes.
setPendingAdmin writes parameter pendingAdmin_ into pendingAdmin.
setPendingAdmin flips admin_initialized to true on the first call.
queueTransaction requires msg.sender == admin before allowing a transaction to be queued.
queueTransaction calls getBlockTimestamp to enforce eta >= now + delay.
queueTransaction invokes SafeMath.add for the delay comparison.
queueTransaction eta flows into SafeMath.add(getBlockTimestamp(), delay) comparison.
delay state variable flows into SafeMath.add used in the queueTransaction eta check.
SafeMath.add performs the raw a + b operation that is the arithmetic boundary of the library.

cancelTransaction data is hashed into the local txHash.

executeTransaction requires msg.sender == admin before any execution logic runs.
executeTransaction calls getBlockTimestamp for the timelock and grace period checks.
executeTransaction invokes SafeMath.add for the grace period bound.
executeTransaction eta flows into SafeMath.add(eta, GRACE_PERIOD).
GRACE_PERIOD constant flows into SafeMath.add for the staleness check.
executeTransaction target is hashed into the local txHash.
executeTransaction value is hashed into the local txHash.
executeTransaction signature is hashed into the local txHash.
executeTransaction data is hashed into the local txHash.
executeTransaction eta is hashed into the local txHash.
executeTransaction clears queuedTransactions[txHash] before the external call.
executeTransaction reads queuedTransactions[txHash] to require the transaction was queued.
executeTransaction signature is hashed to a selector when building callData.
executeTransaction data is appended to the selector to build callData.
User supplied target becomes the callee of the low-level external call.
User supplied value is forwarded as ether in the low-level external call.
Constructed callData is supplied to the low-level external call.
executeTransaction performs a low-level call to an arbitrary target, which can re-enter the timelock or downstream contracts.
success flag is returned by the externally controlled call and only checked afterwards.
returnData is returned by the externally controlled call and forwarded to the caller.
executeTransaction returns the returnData from the external call to its caller.
getBlockTimestamp returns the miner influenceable block.timestamp consumed by the timelock checks.

normalization_plan.reason: admin_ is only used to initialise the admin state variable inside the constructor, so it carries no independent behaviour.
delay_ is only used for bound checks and to initialise delay inside the constructor.
delay_ is a single-use argument that is written straight into the delay state variable.
pendingAdmin_ is written directly into pendingAdmin and has no other role.
target only participates in the txHash computation inside queueTransaction.
value only participates in the txHash computation inside queueTransaction.
signature only participates in the txHash computation inside queueTransaction.
data only participates in the txHash computation inside queueTransaction.
eta is consumed by the timelock comparison and the txHash computation inside queueTransaction.
txHash is a short-lived local derived from the arguments and stored in queuedTransactions inside queueTransaction.
target only participates in the txHash computation inside cancelTransaction.
value only participates in the txHash computation inside cancelTransaction.
signature only participates in the txHash computation inside cancelTransaction.
data only participates in the txHash computation inside cancelTransaction.
eta only participates in the txHash computation inside cancelTransaction.
txHash is a short-lived local used to clear the queued flag inside cancelTransaction.
target is hashed into txHash and used as the callee of the low-level call inside executeTransaction.
value is hashed into txHash and forwarded with the low-level call inside executeTransaction.
signature is hashed into txHash and converted into the call selector inside executeTransaction.
data is hashed into txHash and appended to the callData inside executeTransaction.
eta is hashed into txHash and compared against block.timestamp plus the grace period inside executeTransaction.
txHash is a short-lived local used to read and clear queuedTransactions inside executeTransaction.
callData is a transient buffer assembled only to feed the external call inside executeTransaction.
success is only the immediate result of the external call checked by a require inside executeTransaction.
returnData is only passed through from the external call back to the caller of executeTransaction.
